# Fixture Constitution

## 6. Dice and randomization

### 6.1 Non-LLM RNG

All consequential random outcomes use the OS CSPRNG.

## 7. When to roll

**BOOK:** Roll only when the outcome is uncertain.

### 7.9 Degrees of outcome

**BOOK:** Natural 20 is a Critical Hit.

#### Crazy flourish

**CAMPAIGN:** Every natural 20 gets a flourish.

## 13. Crafting

### 13.7 Traps

Traps need complete entries.
